# Pools By Elio (concept by Kerblabs)

> Concept site for Pools By Elio, a family-run custom pool builder at 412 Ezell Pike, Nashville, TN 37217. Facts from poolsbyelio.net. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the business.

## Facts
- Founders: Jonathan Elio Rodriguez and David Elio Rodriguez
- Phone: (615) 568-3154
- Email: eliocustompools@live.com
- Everything done in-house; licensed, insured and bonded
- 25+ years, 100+ pools built (their site)
- Services: pools and spas, water features, water parks, fountains, backyard concepts (pool houses, pool bars, fire pits)
- Hours: Saturday by appointment; closed Sunday

## FAQ
- Cost: their site says pools start at $140,000+.
